answer_1.quote: We regard radiology report generation as an imageto-text generation task ... generate reports ...
answer_1.outputs: Free-text radiology reports describing chest X-ray images

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the above models by two types of metrics, conventional natural language generation (NLG) metrics and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics ... The NLG metrics include BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L. For CE metrics, the CheXpert is applied ... We use precision, recall and F1 to evaluate model performance for CE metrics.
